verification_instructions: For each page expansion: (1) Run npm run dev and navigate to the page, (2) Verify all sections render without console errors, (3) Test interactive features (filters, modals, forms, dropdowns), (4) Verify responsive layout on desktop, (5) Check that mock data displays correctly
environment_constraints: Lucide-react is the only icon library available. No charting library is currently installed - simple bar charts use CSS widths. React Router DOM v6 is used for navigation. All data is currently mock data from src/data/mockAdminData.js
contribution_requirements: Preserve existing green (#1a6b3c, #1a5c35) branding. Maintain consistent Tailwind classes for buttons (bg-[#1a6b3c] hover:bg-[#145230]), cards (bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200), and status badges. Use existing shared components where applicable. All interactive features must work on the frontend even without backend
key_patterns: Pages follow a consistent structure: (1) Header with title and action buttons, (2) Optional success/info banners, (3) Summary cards with statistics, (4) Search and filter bar in white card, (5) Data table or content sections in white cards, (6) Modals for forms. Status badges use color-coded classes. Mock data uses ISO timestamps. Navigation uses useNavigate hook
directory_structure: src/pages/Admin/ contains all admin pages organized by feature. src/components/admin/ contains admin-specific components (layout, tables, dashboard widgets, ui helpers). src/components/ui/ contains shared UI components. src/data/ contains mock data files. src/services/admin/ contains API service files that return mock data
